instruction: Perform an authorized security assessment of my own Next.js application. Focus on OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, authentication and authorization flaws, IDOR, broken access control, exposed API routes, server actions security, middleware bypasses, XSS, injection vulnerabilities, CSRF, sensitive data exposure, environment variable leaks, security headers, CORS configuration, and Next.js-specific misconfigurations. Avoid destructive actions, data deletion, denial of service, or modifying production data.
